trigger_disclosed: the initial P3 invocation refused at the FIRST probe of the FIRST family's RANDOM floor (reconstruction, seed 9012: adapter could not improve >=1% on random embeddings) — before ANY route or solo encoder was scored; the run produced no other output

clarification.scope_of_minimum_improvement_refusal: ROUTE and SOLO encoders only — there ADAPTER_FAILED_TO_FIT distinguishes representation failure from an underfitted adapter (DATA-SOTA-371)
clarification.random_floor: a floor probe whose adapter cannot reach the 1% improvement records its best-restored val-selected score WITH flag floor_fit_marginal=true — an unfittable probe on random embeddings IS the expected floor signal; refusing it would abolish the reference P2 mandates
clarification.floor_seed_instability: if the FLOOR itself shows material seed instability on a probe, that probe becomes DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID for ranking (raw losses preserved) — an unreliable floor cannot anchor skill

unchanged: route/solo refusals, seeds, budgets, ranking rule, tie tolerance, worse-than-random threshold — all exactly as predeclared
